short_description: Apply Application Insights Instrumentation with explicit validation and safety boundaries.
description: Plan, implement, or review application insights instrumentation work in an existing codebase with compatibility, security, and verification controls. Use when the user explicitly requests application insights instrumentation work.

requires: Local tools appropriate to the requested task
An authorized SandBase connection only for optional external capabilities

install.prompt: Use $appinsights-instrumentation to complete and verify this Application Insights Instrumentation task.
install.cli: npx skills add sandbaseai/sandbase-skills --skill appinsights-instrumentation --agent codex
install.global_cli: npx skills add sandbaseai/sandbase-skills --skill appinsights-instrumentation --agent codex --global

notes: Optional external calls use dynamic SandBase inspection and paid-call confirmation.

endpoints.summary: Inspect live schemas, limits, and pricing.
Recover recent status and observed cost.
Check balance before an approved batch.
